iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_coverage_assessment: Excellent. All target fields are covered by confirmed source candidates. The outbreak timeline is fully documented from investigation announcement (July 25) through closure (August 29, 2025), with multiple dated case/death snapshots. Hospitalizations (90) are confirmed from the Aug 29 closure report. Locality is precise (Central Harlem, specific ZIP codes). Source URLs from nyc.gov are confirmed for at least 5 distinct press releases. Corroborating news sources (healthbeat.org, theguardian.com, infectiousdiseaseadvisor.com, vaccineadvisor.com, goldbergsegalla.com, powershealth.org, nyshcp.org, abc7ny.com, nbcnewyork.com, cbsnews.com, medpagetoday.com, contagionlive.com) provide evidence quotes and cross-validation. The Aug 5 press release (67 cases, 3 deaths) is confirmed via secondary source citation of "New York City Health, news release, Aug. 5, 2025" — the nyc.gov URL for this specific release was not directly surfaced but the Aug 4 update URL was confirmed; the Aug 5 data point is well-corroborated by multiple secondary sources.
iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_trustworthiness_assessment: High. The primary sources are official NYC government domains (nyc.gov, manhattanbp.nyc.gov) with named officials (Dr. Michelle Morse, Mayor Eric Adams, First Deputy Mayor Mastro). Case and death counts are consistent across multiple independent sources and across the outbreak timeline. The nyshcp.org alert (NY State Health Care Providers) provides state-level official corroboration. The healthbeat.org article (Aug 29) provides the most detailed final summary with source identification (Harlem Hospital and new public health lab cooling towers), molecular analysis confirmation, and hospitalization count — all consistent with the nyc.gov closure press release. No implausible or contradictory data points were identified. Social media and academic sources have been appropriately flagged for exclusion.
